name: zanker-responsive-audit
description: Review viewport, container, zoom, long content and touch usability.

workflow.instruction: Audit widths 375,768,1440 and add relevant breakpoint edges.
Inspect horizontal overflow, clipped controls, keyboard overlays and long text.
Check reusable components at different container widths.
Retest after changes and provide screenshots.

fallback: Use browser responsive devtools when Playwright missing.
